name: sql_server_schema_item
expression:
let
    Source = Sql.Database("sql.example.net", "SalesDB"),
    dbo_Sales = Source{[Schema="dbo", Item="Sales"]}[Data]
in
    dbo_Sales

name: sql_server_native_query
expression:
let
    Source = Sql.Database("sql.example.net", "SalesDB", [Query="select * from dbo.Sales"])
in
    Source

name: bigquery_project_dataset_table
expression:
let
    Source = GoogleBigQuery.Database(null),
    proj = Source{[Name="analytics"]}[Data],
    ds = proj{[Name="sales_ds", Kind="Schema"]}[Data],
    tbl = ds{[Name="orders", Kind="Table"]}[Data]
in
    tbl

name: snowflake_database_schema_table
expression:
let
    Source = Snowflake.Databases("acct.snowflakecomputing.com", "WH"),
    db = Source{[Name="ANALYTICS"]}[Data],
    sch = db{[Name="PUBLIC", Kind="Schema"]}[Data],
    tbl = sch{[Name="ORDERS", Kind="Table"]}[Data]
in
    tbl

name: postgresql_name_navigation
expression:
let
    Source = PostgreSQL.Database("pg.example.net", "app"),
    public = Source{[Name="public"]}[Data],
    orders = public{[Name="orders"]}[Data]
in
    orders

name: odbc_query_dsn
expression:
let
    Source = Odbc.Query("dsn=WarehouseDSN;Pwd=example", "select * from reporting.orders")
in
    Source

name: powerbi_dataflow_entity
expression:
let
    Source = PowerBI.Dataflows(null),
    Workspaces = Source{[Id="Workspaces"]}[Data],
    W = Workspaces{[workspaceId="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"]}[Data],
    D = W{[dataflowId="11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"]}[Data],
    E = D{[entity="Attribusi", version=""]}[Data]
in
    E

name: folder_file_content
expression:
let
    Source = Folder.Files("D:\data"),
    F = Source{[#"Folder Path"="D:\data\", Name="a.csv"]}[Content],
    C = Csv.Document(F)
in
    C

name: google_sheets_table
expression:
let
    Source = GoogleSheets.Contents("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/example/edit#gid=1"),
    T = Source{[name="target", ItemKind="Table"]}[Data]
in
    T

name: odata_entity
expression:
let
    Source = OData.Feed("https://example.net/odata"),
    Customers = Source{[Name="Customers"]}[Data]
in
    Customers
